description: Change existing fill layers: colour, gradient and its placement, or pattern (double-clicking the layer thumbnail). Only the options given change. Options by type: solid_color (color); gradient (gradient, style, angle, scale, reverse, dither, alignWithLayer, method, offset); pattern (pattern, patternId, scale, linked).

clip.description: Use Previous Layer to Create Clipping Mask: affect only the layer below

options.description: Settings for the chosen fill; see the list in this tool's description. Omitted settings use Photoshop's defaults

target.description: Fill layers of the given type

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: edit_fill_layer
title: Edit Fill Layer
